summary: A man about 30 snowshoeing on Mt. Princeton with two companions fell approximately 800 feet, suffering serious head, neck, and back injuries; more than 30 responders attended, and Flight for Life picked him up at a landing zone about 1,000 feet from the fall site and flew him to St. Anthony Summit Medical Center in Frisco, from where bad weather forced a ground-ambulance transfer onward to Denver.
responding_agency: Chaffee County Search and Rescue North
notes: Run 995 Mountain Mail chunk: Mountain Mail article reporting a Sunday fall; article record dated 2014-01-27 pins the Sunday to 2014-01-26.
